title.zh: SK海力士第三季度营业利润创纪录，拟回馈股东约100万亿韩元，股价涨超9%
title.en: SK海力士第三季度营业利润创纪录，拟回馈股东约100万亿韩元，股价涨超9%

current_state.zh: SK海力士Q3业绩超预期，营收首次突破100万亿韩元、营业利润创纪录，并确认约100万亿韩元股东回报计划；长期供应协议和HBM4放量预期强化了AI内存上行周期叙事，摩根大通维持增持评级并给出较现价约105%上涨空间的目标价。
current_state.en: SK Hynix's Q3 results beat expectations, with revenue above 100 trillion KRW for the first time and record operating profit, alongside a confirmed ~100 trillion KRW shareholder return plan; long-term supply agreements and HBM4 ramp expectations reinforce the AI memory upcycle narrative, and JPMorgan reiterated Overweight with a target implying about 105% upside.

updates.what_changed_zh: SK海力士公布第三季度营业利润达83.3万亿韩元，创历史新高，受AI驱动的存储需求推动，并公布约100万亿韩元的股东回报计划，其股价上涨逾9%。
updates.what_changed_en: SK Hynix reported record Q3 operating profit of 83.3 trillion KRW on AI-driven memory demand and unveiled a ~100 trillion KRW shareholder return program, sending its shares up over 9%.

updates.title_zh: SK海力士Q3财报超预期，摩根大通给出翻倍上涨空间目标价
updates.title_en: SK海力士Q3财报超预期，摩根大通给出翻倍上涨空间目标价
updates.what_changed_zh: 同一份SK海力士Q3财报披露更多细节：营收104.6155万亿韩元首次突破100万亿，营业利润率近80%；公司重申约100万亿韩元股东回报计划，并披露14家客户长期供应协议覆盖2027-2028年超50%产能、HBM4预计Q4超越HBM3E、存储供不应求或持续至2030年；摩根大通维持增持评级并给出2,750,000韩元目标价。
updates.what_changed_en: The same SK Hynix Q3 report added details: revenue of 104.6155 trillion KRW, first above 100 trillion, with nearly 80% operating margin; the ~100 trillion KRW shareholder return plan was reiterated alongside 14 long-term supply agreements covering over 50% of 2027-2028 capacity, expectations that HBM4 will surpass HBM3E in Q4, and a supply shortage potentially lasting to 2030; JPMorgan maintained Overweight with a 2,750,000 KRW target price.
updates.current_state_zh: SK海力士Q3业绩超预期，营收首次突破100万亿韩元、营业利润创纪录，并确认约100万亿韩元股东回报计划；长期供应协议和HBM4放量预期强化了AI内存上行周期叙事，摩根大通维持增持评级并给出较现价约105%上涨空间的目标价。
updates.current_state_en: SK Hynix's Q3 results beat expectations, with revenue above 100 trillion KRW for the first time and record operating profit, alongside a confirmed ~100 trillion KRW shareholder return plan; long-term supply agreements and HBM4 ramp expectations reinforce the AI memory upcycle narrative, and JPMorgan reiterated Overweight with a target implying about 105% upside.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: SK Hynix reported record Q3 results — revenue above 100 trillion KRW and ~80% operating margin on AI-driven HBM4, server DRAM and eSSD demand — beating consensus, and announced ~100 trillion KRW of 2026 shareholder returns while JPMorgan reiterated Overweight with a 2,750,000 KRW target, citing sold-out DRAM/HBM capacity through 2029 and undersupply lasting to 2030.
updates.detailed_summary_en: SK Hynix reported record Q3 results — revenue above 100 trillion KRW and ~80% operating margin on AI-driven HBM4, server DRAM and eSSD demand — beating consensus, and announced ~100 trillion KRW of 2026 shareholder returns while JPMorgan reiterated Overweight with a 2,750,000 KRW target, citing sold-out DRAM/HBM capacity through 2029 and undersupply lasting to 2030.
